headline: Lisandro Martínez: I believe in 'everyone working to help' Man United 'move forward'
description: Lisandro Martínez has said he believes in "my teammates, our manager and everyone working to help this club move forward."

headline: Sources: Man United assessing Martínez comments as player releases statement
description: Manchester United bosses are assessing Lisandro Martínez's comments in the aftermath of the 2-0 defeat to Atletico Madrid before deciding whether to take disciplinary action against the Argentina defender, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool eye move for Juventus' Kalulu
description: Liverpool are reportedly linked with a move for Juventus defender Pierre Kalulu. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Mikel Merino says Arsenal are 'ready' for Premier League, Champions League double
description: Mikel Merino insists Arsenal are ready to go one better than last season and complete a Premier League and Champions League double.

headline: Andy Burnham: Man City owners didn't mention Premier League charges in meeting
description: Andy Burnham has said Manchester City's owners and directors did not raise the Premier League's charges against the club when he met with them.
